disagreements.title: 33 colour tokens share only 12 distinct value(s) in light mode
disagreements.detail:
39 colour token(s) resolve to 18 distinct light value(s). Where two names always carry the same value, a reader cannot tell which one a screen should use:
- #ffffff: --bg-elevated, --bg-surface, --text-on-dark
- #9a9cab: --text-muted, --availability-unavailable
- #141627: --text-primary, --brand-on-accent, --brand-on-primary, --colors-eerie-black
- #626577: --text-secondary, --border-strong, --colors-dark-electric-blue
- #66d0f2: --brand-accent, --state-info, --colors-blue-sky, --trust-verified
- #d0d4e7: --brand-accent-soft, --trust-verified-soft
- #d1f366: --brand-primary, --colors-boogie-buster, --colors-spring-green
- #5a731a: --brand-primary-active, --state-success, --availability-available
- #b8dc4b: --brand-primary-hover, --colors-boogie-buster-dark
- #ffd365: --state-warning, --availability-limited, --colors-sunset-orange
- #dddddd: --border-subtle, --bg-input-bg-hover
- #f3f3f3: --bg-input-bg, --colors-off-white

disagreements.title: 1 colour token(s) have no dark value
disagreements.detail: They keep their light value in dark mode: --colors-border-line-gray.

disagreements.title: 15 token(s) are declared and never used
disagreements.detail: No utility class and no `var()` reference spends them: --scheme-on-surface, --scheme-surface, --colors-border-line-gray, --spacing-s0, --colors-blue-sky, --colors-boogie-buster-dark, --colors-boogie-buster, --colors-dark-electric-blue, --colors-eerie-black, --colors-gray, --colors-off-white, --colors-peach-red, --colors-spring-green, --colors-sunset-orange, --colors-yankees-blue.

disagreements.title: 780 hardcoded colour literal(s) bypass the tokens
disagreements.detail: Written into a colour property or an arbitrary class value; 168 duplicate a token that already exists.
